what: Movement inside sections: what changes over 8, 16 or 32 bars so a loop does not sit still. production is a patch of transition moves for the production recipe (recipes: lowpass_open, lowpass_dip, filter_sweep, filter_wobble, reverb_throw, fade_in, pitch_rise, gap, stutter_fill, reverse_fill, tape_stop, fx_swell); manual moves are done with add_automation_clip on the named parameter.

options.label: A low-pass opening over 16 bars
options.what: The arp or chord pluck starts dark and its cutoff opens over a whole 16-bar phrase, peaking as the next phrase starts: the afro house and melodic techno way of building without a riser.

sources.where: FLEX Arp cutoff opened over 16 bars
Filter - Arp cutoff clips of 32, 72 and 140 beats

options.label: Pluck decay and release ridden longer through the drop
options.what: The chord pluck's decay (or a FLEX pluck's release) grows over the drop, so the same notes go from tight to washed: Bien Duro rides its glass pluck's release and unison, Africa's Calling its Harmless decay.

sources.where: Glass pluck (Harmor): release, decay and unison automated
BAS Lottunma Release, 11 points over 128 beats

options.manual: add_automation_clip on the pluck's decay or release knob: 30 % at the drop's start to 70 % at its end.

options.label: FLEX macros moving over a phrase
options.what: FLEX presets expose macros (Space, Metal, Plucked, OSCEX, TuneX, FlungDL): melodic techno moves two or three of them across 16 to 64 beats so one preset changes character inside the song.

sources.where: PLK Shirin OSCEX and FlungDL over 64 beats, LED Kian Metal, Plucked, LPF and arpeggio gate over 16

options.manual: set_plugin_param_by_name and add_automation_clip on the FLEX channel's macro knobs.

options.label: Master reverb up for the breakdown, thrown out on the drop
options.what: The breakdown sits in a big reverb (master or music bus wet up); the last beats before the drop throw it out so the drop arrives dry and close.

sources.where: Reeverb 2 - Master wet level clips over 930 beats
Vocal Reverb Balance and Gross Beat gate automated

options.label: Delay throws on phrase ends
options.what: Short automation clips open a delay send only on the last word of a phrase, so the echo fills the gap and never runs under the next line.

sources.where: reverb and delay throws as short automation clips
Delay 3 input wet, 30 points over 384 beats

options.manual: add_automation_clip on the vocal delay send level: 0 through the phrase, up on its last beat, back to 0 on the next downbeat.

options.label: Low end taken out of the break with an EQ band
options.what: An EQ band's frequency on the low-frequency bus rises in the breakdown (a moving high-pass) and falls back for the drop, so the drop's bass feels new.

sources.where: EQ 2 (Slot 4) - Low FRQ - Band 1 freq, 18 points over 416 beats

options.label: Filter wobble on the lead, one beat at a time
options.what: One short filter clip repeated on every beat of the lead (the reference repeats a one-beat clip 64 times): movement locked to the tempo.

options.label: Formant shifts on ad-libs and samples
options.what: An ethnic or vocal sample's formant moved over a few beats (Mehdi's setar ad-lib, Mehran's vocal formant over the song), so a repeated sample changes colour without changing pitch.

sources.where: Setar Adlib formant shift amount over 6 beats
PitchShifter - Main Vocal - Formant over 384 beats

options.manual: add_automation_clip on the channel's formant knob or a Pitch Shifter's formant on the vocal insert.

options.label: A tempo change for a new scene
options.what: The tempo moves for a section (120 to 110 in a soundtrack cue; a slow-down into a breakdown): an automation clip on the project tempo.
options.manual: A tempo clip moves every vocal and audio clip's timing: only on instrumental passages, or with the vocal re-stretched for the new tempo.
